prompt: Can you guide me through training a custom ESRGAN model for upscaling game textures?
response: To train a custom ESRGAN model for upscaling game textures, start by preparing a dataset of low-resolution and high-resolution texture pairs. Use the ESRGAN GitHub repository as a starting point and modify the configuration file to suit your needs. Adjust parameters like the number of residual blocks and training epochs. Implement data augmentation techniques to increase the diversity of your training set. Use a powerful GPU to accelerate the training process. Evaluate the model's performance using a separate validation set and make adjustments as necessary.
